# Andy S.

> Andy S. is a bolivian contemporary artist based in Curitiba, Brazil. Works mainly with painting, using techniques such as oil painting, ink painting and watercolor.

Andy S. is a bolivian artist currently living in Curitiba, Brazil.
Inspired by the beauty of hidden emotions in the world around him, he creates paintings that unearth deep feelings capturing the inner world of the individual.
Andy works focused on figurative art, expressionism and minimalism, however, his work is under constant experimentation.
His contemporary artworks focus above all on the human figure.
While mostly known for his oil paintings and ink drawings, Andy S. has also experience as a watercolorist and digital illustrator.

## Exhibitions

- [Cor ne edito](https://bolienvano.com/exhibitions/cor-ne-edito.html): opened 2023-06-22, Cultural Center Casa Melchor Pinto, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. "Do not consume the heart" is the phrase that inspires this art exhibition: twelve watercolor portraits of women exploring various nuances of human anguish.
- [Hiperconciencia](https://bolienvano.com/exhibitions/hiperconciencia.html): opened 2022-08-04, Contemporary Art Museum, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. The exhibition, made up of works done in nanking ink on Canson paper, presents us with female figures portrayed in black and white, portrayed with pensive expressions and a certain degree of melancholy. The main theme deals with altered perceptions of reality from the perspective of hidden emotions, often mistakenly considered as something negative.
- [Introspección](https://bolienvano.com/exhibitions/introspeccion.html): opened 2021-07-31, Picasso Gallery Garten Shopping, Joinville, Brazil. In Introspección the works present opaque colors and empty backgrounds. With the frequent use of black, occupying large portions of the canvas, the artist seeks to materialize anguishes and anxieties that remain present or that rush the person, limiting his ability to see reality beyond his four walls.
